row.team_price_text: $45/month per workspace (4 seats included; extra agents $10/month)
row.evidence: Crisp's pricing comparison lists Double-Factor Authentication under Data & Security but no SSO or SCIM, and agents are added by invitation: 'You can do this directly from the workspace settings by entering their email address and choosing the appropriate role.'
row.notes: None by absence: SCIM, SAML/OIDC SSO and directory sync are not on the pricing page (including the Enterprise box), in the English help-centre sitemap (312 article URLs) or in the REST API reference. Pricing is flat per workspace, not per user: Free (2 seats), Mini $45/mo (4 seats), Essentials $95/mo (10), Plus $295/mo (20+), extra agents $10/mo. Prices are monthly; yearly billing can be switched on in the app, with no yearly price published. The REST API (Developer APIs on every plan) can list and read operators and manage teams with website or plugin tokens. Invite, change-role and unlink operator endpoints list only the 'user' tier. Operator sign-in options include password, token (2FA) and Google, which is social sign-in, not customer-IdP SSO.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Enterprise lists dedicated onboarding, a personalised SLA, enhanced rate limits and custom features. SSO and SCIM are not mentioned.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint, SSO or IdP integration is documented.

user_api.notes: Operators (agents) are workspace members with the role owner or member. Get/list operator endpoints accept user, website and plugin tiers (scope website:operators). Invite, change membership and unlink list only the 'user' tier.

auth.notes: Permanent token keypair: a website token from Settings > Workspace Settings > Advanced configuration, or a plugin token from the Crisp Marketplace.

capabilities.notes: delete_user is 'Unlink Operator From Website' (removes workspace access; the last operator cannot be unlinked). assign_roles means switching between owner and member. Groups are Crisp teams.

rate_limits.text: Multi-level rate limits (edge, API-wide, per-route) by client IP and user identifier; plugin tokens also have a daily request quota. Plus and Enterprise advertise enhanced rate limits.

limitations.text: Invite, change-role and unlink operator endpoints are documented for the 'user' tier only, not for website or plugin tokens.

entra.notes: No Crisp tutorial in Microsoft Learn's saas-apps table of contents.

fallbacks.notes: Agents are invited by email from workspace settings. No SSO, so no JIT.
